title: Python Studio production-readiness corrections
summary: Fix verified small-screen overflow, light-theme contrast, cross-file undo, prompt tab stealing and native draft debounce loss.

changes.detail: Small-screen running toolbar overflow reproduced in Chromium. Correcting compact actions, keyboard-bounded menu, light-theme status/error/dirty colors and Run hover contrast.

Reset editor undo history on explicit document switches, preserve same-document saves, and only select Console when a new input prompt arrives. Emit native working drafts immediately instead of waiting for the 300ms autosave.
Accessible tablist keyboard controls and bounded native draft validation.
Memoize the editor with stable editing/run callbacks and avoid duplicate viewport state updates. Extend browser review to both themes, 280px screens and edge cases.

validation.name: Baseline browser review
validation.detail: English dark-theme running toolbar overflow reproduced at 280px. Static contrast calculation found light Stop at 1.56:1, error text at 1.93:1, dirty marker at 1.74:1 and Run hover text at 3.77:1. Final checks pending.

validation.detail: No device or native binary validation claimed. Browser snapshots and automated tests will verify the shared implementation.
